svg.text: A STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE
Planning Your Garden with Claude
Who's in charge the whole time? You are.
Tools needed: the Claude app and one folder. Watch the tomato grow as you go!
You pick one folder
Claude can only see inside this one
folder — like handing a helper one
drawer of your desk. Email, photos, and
banking stay invisible to it.
IT WILL ASK YOU FIRST:
"May I use the folder 'Garden Project'?"
You click Allow — or Don't Allow.
You say what you want, in plain words
No commands. No codes. No jargon.
You type — or even speak — exactly the
way you'd talk to a friendly landscaper.
Claude asks YOU questions
It interviews you like a good contractor:
How big is the yard? What do you
love to eat? How much weeding do
you really want to do?
You're steering the whole conversation.
Claude shows its plan — you approve it
Before doing anything, Claude says:
"Here's what I'll create: a garden layout,
a planting calendar, a shopping list. OK?"
IT WILL ASK YOU FIRST:
Say yes, say no, or change the plan.
If it wants to search the internet, it asks about that first, too.
Claude works — you watch
It narrates as it goes, like a helper
talking through their work:
"Now I'm making your planting
calendar…"
Press Stop at any moment, for
any reason. It stops right away.
You get real, ordinary files
Everything lands in that one folder —
documents you open, print, and share
like any other file. Take the shopping
list straight to the nursery.
The rest of your computer? Untouched, exactly as you left it.
Three things to remember
1. It only sees the one folder you choose.
2. It always asks before it acts.
3. You can stop it anytime — you're the boss.
